- Remit/account nickname we use internally is "CarePlus Operating" (ACH).

Samir — thanks, received both attachments. A couple of next steps from our side so we can complete onboarding this morning: 
1) We'll kick off a micro-deposit to the ACH account you shared to validate the routing/account. Please confirm with us once you see the two test deposits (we'll send reference and amounts).
2) Can you confirm whether invoices should carry both a PO and a re-bill reference? If only PO is needed, we'll map on our side to label invoices with the PO as CP-INV-<PO#>.
3) If you have a preferred remittance email for automatic payment notices (different from payables@careplushealth.io), send that too.

FYI, I'm adding Aditya (payments / procurement ops) and Ben (finops) on copy to expedite the vendor portal activation. We'll attach your docs to the vendor record and complete the payment-channel activation once micro-deposit confirms.

Procurement checklist link: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/browse/PROCV-412 (internal)

Thanks — I'll flag when the test posts.
